Methodology (ADR docs/internal/adr/adr-benchmark-methodology-provisional-policy.md, site methodology page): 1 warm-up plus at least 3 measured iterations; median with min/max spread; noise floor 1.25 x largest spread over 5 same-class runs; published results are warm-state only; hardware is not a ranking facet; regression threshold 10% plus floor. Open with no answer: whether the 'Derived from' wording satisfies EULA clause 4c(3), and the citation format for third parties.
CLI (PR #4276): --non-interactive counts as non-interactive for the driver auto-install gate; package-smoke runs on any benchbox/** change; orphan-spin report thresholds 50% CPU for 300 s.

Outcome: each line is confirmed or amended by the owner, and amendments are filed as items.
